dialogues.jp: なんとなく分かっていた。
dialogues.en: I kind of knew.
dialogues.text: I kind of knew.

dialogues.jp:
と言うか、こうなるのは分かっていたはずなの
だ。
dialogues.en:
Well actually, I was supposed to know what could happen
next.
dialogues.text:
Well actually, I was supposed to know what could happen
next.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おいしいね♪」
dialogues.en: "It's so good."
dialogues.text: "It's so good."

dialogues.jp:
正面に腰かけるさくらが、たぬきそばの｛か／掻｝き揚
げを汁に沈める。
dialogues.en:
Sakura's sitting in front of me, putting fried bits with
soba noodle into the soup.
dialogues.text:
Sakura's sitting in front of me, putting fried bits with
soba noodle into the soup.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「こうやると、ダシが効くから良いよね。ちょっ
　と歯ごたえがなくなっちゃうんだけどさ」
dialogues.en:
"The soup broth makes them tasty by doing this, but they get
soggy, though."
dialogues.text:
"The soup broth makes them tasty by doing this, but they get
soggy, though."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「もう少し静かに食えないか？」
dialogues.en: "Can you be a bit quieter?"
dialogues.text: "Can you be a bit quieter?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ぶぅ……食堂でフレンドリーに食べないでど
　うするの？　最後の晩餐じゃないんだよ？」
dialogues.en:
"Boo... How can you enjoy eating quietly? It's not like this
is the Last Supper."
dialogues.text:
"Boo... How can you enjoy eating quietly? It's not like this
is the Last Supper."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、まぁ、そうだな」
dialogues.en: "Um... I suppose not."
dialogues.text: "Um... I suppose not."

dialogues.jp:
ため息をつきながら、定食の焼鮭の骨をとって
いく。
dialogues.en:
Letting out a sigh, I pick the bones out of the grilled
salmon I ordered.
dialogues.text:
Letting out a sigh, I pick the bones out of the grilled
salmon I ordered.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「はにゃ……お兄ちゃん、ボクとお昼食べるの
　嫌なのかなぁ？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm... Don't you like eating lunch with me, oniichan?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm... Don't you like eating lunch with me, oniichan?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや、そういうことじゃなくて」
dialogues.en: "No, that's not what it is."
dialogues.text: "No, that's not what it is."

dialogues.jp: 思わず苦笑しながら味噌汁を手にとる。
dialogues.en: I grab some soup with a wan smile.
dialogues.text: I grab some soup with a wan smile.

dialogues.jp:
「他の女の子ならともかく、まさか、お前と昼
　飯を食うのなんて想像出来なかったからなぁ」
dialogues.en:
"I can think of eating lunch with other girls, but I never
expected eating with you like this."
dialogues.text:
"I can think of eating lunch with other girls, but I never
expected eating with you like this."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、他の女の子と一緒だったりしてた？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, have you ever eaten with other girls?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, have you ever eaten with other girls?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「してたり、してなかったり、ってところだ」
dialogues.en: "Probably I have, probably I haven't."
dialogues.text: "Probably I have, probably I haven't."

dialogues.jp:
鍋をつついたりしたこともあるが、余計な騒ぎ
になりそうで言うのはやめた。
dialogues.en:
I've eaten hot pot at the table with other girls, but I
decide not to tell her about it to stay out of trouble.
dialogues.text:
I've eaten hot pot at the table with other girls, but I
decide not to tell her about it to stay out of trouble.

dialogues.jp:
そう言えば、萌先輩とさくらを会わせたらどう
なるのか、凄く気になるな……。
dialogues.en: I wonder what'd happen if I introduced Sakura to Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: I wonder what'd happen if I introduced Sakura to Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp:
昼休みの時間が余ったら屋上にでも行ってみる
か。でも、鍋の現場を見られたら眞子が怒るな。
dialogues.en:
I may go check on the rooftop if I have extra time after
lunch. But Mako wouldn't like it if I see the place where
the hot pot's cooked.
dialogues.text:
I may go check on the rooftop if I have extra time after
lunch. But Mako wouldn't like it if I see the place where
the hot pot's cooked.

dialogues.jp: 「ふむ」
dialogues.en: "Hm."
dialogues.text: "Hm."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「もぅ、購買のパンとかも売りきれちゃってる
　だろうなぁ」
dialogues.en: "They must be out of bread in the store by now."
dialogues.text: "They must be out of bread in the store by now."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい、ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, sorry."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
なにか手段とタイミングがないか考えていると
当人達の声が耳についた。
dialogues.en:
As I think about how to get up on the roof, I happen to hear
their voices.
dialogues.text:
As I think about how to get up on the roof, I happen to hear
their voices.

dialogues.jp: ぺこぺこ――という音まで聞こえてきそうだ。
dialogues.en: I can almost hear the sound of bows.
dialogues.text: I can almost hear the sound of bows.

dialogues.jp: 「眞子っ、萌先輩！」
dialogues.en: "Mako, Moe-sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Mako, Moe-sempai!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　あぁ、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "Huh? Oh, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Huh? Oh, Asakura."

dialogues.jp:
食堂の入り口にいた眞子が、手を振り返してく
れる。
dialogues.en: Mako waves to me from the entrance to the dining hall.
dialogues.text: Mako waves to me from the entrance to the dining hall.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりは遠くで何事か言いあうと、萌先輩だけ
がこちらに歩いてきて、眞子は購買に向かって
いった。
dialogues.en:
They exchange a few words in the distance, and then
Moe-sempai walks toward me while Mako walks to the store.
dialogues.text:
They exchange a few words in the distance, and then
Moe-sempai walks toward me while Mako walks to the store.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「知り合い？」
dialogues.en: "Do you know them?"
dialogues.text: "Do you know them?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ、あっちの付属の制服着てるのはクラス
　メイトの眞子で、彼女はそのお姉さんの萌先
　輩だ」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah. The girl wearing the uniform is my classmate Mako,
and this is Moe-sempai, Mako's big sister."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah. The girl wearing the uniform is my classmate Mako,
and this is Moe-sempai, Mako's big sister."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「マコマコは知ってる」
dialogues.en: "I know Makomako."
dialogues.text: "I know Makomako."

dialogues.jp:
すでに愛称つきで、さくらは主に萌先輩を気に
しているらしい。
dialogues.en:
She already calls Mako a nickname, but she seems to be
worried about Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text:
She already calls Mako a nickname, but she seems to be
worried about Moe-sempai.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「授業中、寝てたんですか先輩」
dialogues.en: "You had a nap in the middle of class, didn't you?"
dialogues.text: "You had a nap in the middle of class, didn't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あれ？　なんで分かりました？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? How did you know?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? How did you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ｈａｈａｈａ、どうしてでしょうねぇ」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha, guess!"
dialogues.text: "Hahaha, guess!"

dialogues.jp: どうしたって分かる。
dialogues.en: It's not that difficult to figure out.
dialogues.text: It's not that difficult to figure out.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「で、こちらは？」
dialogues.en: "Well, who's this lady?"
dialogues.text: "Well, who's this lady?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクは芳乃さくら、一昨日転入してきました」
dialogues.en:
"I'm Sakura Yoshino. I'm a new student here as of
yesterday."
dialogues.text:
"I'm Sakura Yoshino. I'm a new student here as of
yesterday."

dialogues.jp:
意外にも、さくらがしっかりとした――普通の
自己紹介をしただけで場が落ち着く。
dialogues.en:
To my surprise and relief, she introduces herself in a
sensible way.
dialogues.text:
To my surprise and relief, she introduces herself in a
sensible way.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゅ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: おわっ！
dialogues.en: Wow!
dialogues.text: Wow!

dialogues.jp: 「先輩、ちょっと！」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Moe-sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Moe-sempai!"

dialogues.jp:
肩を揺らしてみるが、しっかりと爆睡モードに
入っていらっしゃる。
dialogues.en:
I shake her shoulders, but she's already switched to sleep
mode.
dialogues.text:
I shake her shoulders, but she's already switched to sleep
mode.

dialogues.jp: 「……駄目か」
dialogues.en: "Damn it!"
dialogues.text: "Damn it!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「徹夜でもしたのかな？」
dialogues.en: "She must have studied through the night."
dialogues.text: "She must have studied through the night."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「いや……いつも通りだ」
dialogues.en: "No, this is normal for her."
dialogues.text: "No, this is normal for her."

dialogues.jp:
よく考えれば、萌先輩に誰を会わせてもこうな
ることは予想の範囲内か……。
dialogues.en:
When I think about it carefully, I should expect things like
this when I introduce anybody to her.
dialogues.text:
When I think about it carefully, I should expect things like
this when I introduce anybody to her.

dialogues.jp:
「多分、さくらの自己紹介も覚えていないだろ
　うから、次に会ったときには何事もなかった
　かのように最初からだ」
dialogues.en:
"She probably won't remember you, Sakura, so she'll act like
a stranger when she sees you next time."
dialogues.text:
"She probably won't remember you, Sakura, so she'll act like
a stranger when she sees you next time."

dialogues.jp: 体験者が語る。
dialogues.en: I speak from experience.
dialogues.text: I speak from experience.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "My, my, my~"
dialogues.text: "My, my, my~"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「駄目だ、購買は売りきれてたよお姉ちゃん
　……って、寝てるね」
dialogues.en:
"Nope. The store's sold out of everything, oneechan... Oh,
she's sleeping."
dialogues.text:
"Nope. The store's sold out of everything, oneechan... Oh,
she's sleeping."

dialogues.jp: さくらの隣に腰掛けて眞子が肩をすくめる。
dialogues.en: Mako shrugs her shoulders and sits next to Sakura.
dialogues.text: Mako shrugs her shoulders and sits next to Sakura.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「で、噂の転入生――さくらちゃん」
dialogues.en: "So, Sakura-chan, you're the new student."
dialogues.text: "So, Sakura-chan, you're the new student."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ」
dialogues.en: "Yep."
dialogues.text: "Yep."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あたしは水越眞子。｛ふしょうぶしょう／不承不承｝ながら朝倉のク
　ラスメイト」
dialogues.en:
"My name is Mako Mizukoshi. I'm in the same class as
Asakura, unfortunately."
dialogues.text:
"My name is Mako Mizukoshi. I'm in the same class as
Asakura, unfortunately."

dialogues.jp:
なんだかトゲのある言葉だが、ぱっと見に問題
のあるさくらにも普段通り接してくれるコイツ
が｛さすが／流石｝だ。
dialogues.en:
Those are stinging words, but I'm glad she seems to be happy
to chat with Sakura.
dialogues.text:
Those are stinging words, but I'm glad she seems to be happy
to chat with Sakura.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「えへへへ。ボク、芳乃さくら。残念ながらお
　兄ちゃんと別のクラスです」
dialogues.en:
"Teehee. I'm Sakura Yoshino. Unfortunately, I'm not in the
same class as oniichan."
dialogues.text:
"Teehee. I'm Sakura Yoshino. Unfortunately, I'm not in the
same class as oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「偉いぞさくら、ちゃんと一人で自己紹介でき
　たな」
dialogues.en: "Well done, Sakura. You introduced yourself all alone."
dialogues.text: "Well done, Sakura. You introduced yourself all alone."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「子供じゃないっての！！」
dialogues.en: "I'm not a little kid!!"
dialogues.text: "I'm not a little kid!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ぐがっ！？」
足の甲に衝撃が走る。
dialogues.en: I feel a sharp pain on the instep of my foot.
dialogues.text: I feel a sharp pain on the instep of my foot.

dialogues.jp:
「冗談なのに……ふ……まぁ、音夢ほどではな
　い」
dialogues.en: "I was only joking... Oh well, it's not as bad as Nemu."
dialogues.text: "I was only joking... Oh well, it's not as bad as Nemu."

dialogues.jp:
自分でもわけの分からない立ち直り方をして、
そのまま頬杖をついて眞子を見る。
dialogues.en:
As the pain subsides, I rest my chin in my hand and look at
Mako.
dialogues.text:
As the pain subsides, I rest my chin in my hand and look at
Mako.

dialogues.jp: 「で、鍋はどうしたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "So, how's the hot pot cooking going?"
dialogues.text: "So, how's the hot pot cooking going?"

dialogues.jp: さすがに金銭的に息切れしてきたのか。
dialogues.en: You've got to think they must run out of money for that.
dialogues.text: You've got to think they must run out of money for that.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「それが、お姉ちゃんが食材持ってくるの忘れ
　たのよ。鴨入りの南蛮鍋」
dialogues.en:
"Actually, oneechan forgot to bring the ingredients. It was
supposed to be a Western dish with duck."
dialogues.text:
"Actually, oneechan forgot to bring the ingredients. It was
supposed to be a Western dish with duck."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「今日は南蛮鍋だったのか」
dialogues.en: "So I could've had a Western dish today?"
dialogues.text: "So I could've had a Western dish today?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「｛・・・・／鴨入りの｝南蛮鍋よ！」
dialogues.en: "It's Western hot pot with duck!"
dialogues.text: "It's Western hot pot with duck!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「南蛮ねぇ」
dialogues.en: "Western, I see."
dialogues.text: "Western, I see."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「鴨入りだって言ってるでしょ！」
dialogues.en: "I told you it's with duck!"
dialogues.text: "I told you it's with duck!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……分かってるよ」
dialogues.en: "I know."
dialogues.text: "I know."

dialogues.jp:
しかしブルジョアジーだな。貧富の差よりは、
食生活の違いが｛うらや／羨｝ましいが。
dialogues.en:
They're so bourgeois. I'm not envious of their wealth so
much as what they eat.
dialogues.text:
They're so bourgeois. I'm not envious of their wealth so
much as what they eat.

dialogues.jp:
「とりあえず、昼飯抜きか？　俺の残りでよけ
　れば食べてもいいぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"So, no lunch, huh? You can have mine if you don't mind
leftovers."
dialogues.text:
"So, no lunch, huh? You can have mine if you don't mind
leftovers."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「いいわよ。ダイエットだと思えば」
dialogues.en: "Don't worry about me. I try to think that I'm on a diet."
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about me. I try to think that I'm on a diet."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そうか」
dialogues.en: "Really."
dialogues.text: "Really."

dialogues.jp: 爽やかな笑みに、爽やかに返す。
dialogues.en: She replies breezily with a refreshing smile.
dialogues.text: She replies breezily with a refreshing smile.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……あにゃ」

と、さくらが自分の椀を見つめて、にこりと眞
子に微笑む。
dialogues.en: Sakura looks at her own bowl and smiles at Mako.
dialogues.text: Sakura looks at her own bowl and smiles at Mako.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクのおそば食べる？」
dialogues.en: "Would you like to have some of my soba?"
dialogues.text: "Would you like to have some of my soba?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そう、くれるならちょっと頂戴」
dialogues.en: "Oh, really? Are you sure?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, really? Are you sure?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「待てやコラ！」
dialogues.en: "Hey, wait!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, wait!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なによ、あたしがもらったんだからね」
dialogues.en: "C'mon! She asked me first."
dialogues.text: "C'mon! She asked me first."

dialogues.jp: 椀を抱えて眞子が目を細める。
dialogues.en: Mako narrows her eyes, holding the bowl in her hands.
dialogues.text: Mako narrows her eyes, holding the bowl in her hands.

dialogues.jp:
「違う！　どうして俺の鮭定食が駄目で、そば
　が食えるんだ！？」
dialogues.en:
"It's not that! How can you refuse the grilled salmon I
offered, but accept her soba?!"
dialogues.text:
"It's not that! How can you refuse the grilled salmon I
offered, but accept her soba?!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「男女の差よ」
dialogues.en: "It's the difference between a man and a woman."
dialogues.text: "It's the difference between a man and a woman."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「同じ｛オトコ／漢｝だろう！？」
dialogues.en: "We're the same sex, aren't we?"
dialogues.text: "We're the same sex, aren't we?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あたしが女以外の何に見えるの！！」
dialogues.en: "How can you see me anything other than a woman?!"
dialogues.text: "How can you see me anything other than a woman?!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「漢に決まってるだろうが！！」
dialogues.en: "You must be a man!"
dialogues.text: "You must be a man!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……瞬殺だ」
dialogues.en: "...Prepare to die."
dialogues.text: "...Prepare to die."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「杉並より先にお前と決着をつけなくてはなら
　ないとはな」
dialogues.en:
"I never thought I'd settle things with you before I do with
Suginami."
dialogues.text:
"I never thought I'd settle things with you before I do with
Suginami."

dialogues.jp: 汗が頬にながれた。
dialogues.en: Something drips down my cheek.
dialogues.text: Something drips down my cheek.

dialogues.jp:
気になるが、汗をぬぐう隙を見せただけで｛や／殺｝ら
れる……。
dialogues.en:
It's distracting, but I don't want to open myself up by
wiping away the sweat.
dialogues.text:
It's distracting, but I don't want to open myself up by
wiping away the sweat.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "Aaahh... Um..."
dialogues.text: "Aaahh... Um..."

dialogues.jp: と、萌先輩がむくりと頭を上げて眞子を見た。
dialogues.en: Moe-sempai suddenly lifts her head and looks at Mako.
dialogues.text: Moe-sempai suddenly lifts her head and looks at Mako.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい、ごめんなさい」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, sorry."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「お姉ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "Oneechan?"
dialogues.text: "Oneechan?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「もぅ、私ぽけぽけしてて……またなにかやり
　ました？」
dialogues.en: "What a dork I am... Did I bother you?"
dialogues.text: "What a dork I am... Did I bother you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ〜」
dialogues.en: "Geez..."
dialogues.text: "Geez..."

dialogues.jp:
さくらのため息と一緒に、昼休みの終わりを告
げる予鈴が鳴った。
dialogues.en:
As soon as Sakura sighs, the bell rings for the end of lunch
break.
dialogues.text:
As soon as Sakura sighs, the bell rings for the end of lunch
break.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくらｖｓ萌先輩◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura vs. Moe-sempai◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura vs. Moe-sempai◆

dialogues.jp:
さくらと食堂でご飯を食べていると、萌先輩と
眞子と相席することになった。
dialogues.en:
When I was eating lunch with Sakura in the dining hall,
Moe-sempai and Mako came to join us.
dialogues.text:
When I was eating lunch with Sakura in the dining hall,
Moe-sempai and Mako came to join us.

dialogues.jp:
珍しい組み合わせと、さくらと萌先輩のマイペー
ス同士の会話が見物かと思ったが、あいかわら
ずの萌先輩に敗北するさくらだった。
dialogues.en:
I thought it would be entertaining to listen to the
conversation between Moe-sempai and Sakura, but actually it
